1. (Currently amended) A belly pan for a motor vehicle, comprising: a body panel having a forward section constructed from an open rib structure __with a plurality of closed ribs flanking said open rib structure__; and an aero cover carried on said body panel and spanning said open rib structure __and bonded thereto__.

2. (Currently amended) The belly pan of claim 1, wherein said body panel includes a first forward corner and a second forward corner __that are structurally separated by said plurality of closed ribs__.

3. (Currently amended) The belly pan of claim 2, wherein said first forward corner includes a first section of open rib structure and said second forward corner includes a second section of open rib structure __each positioned between distinct pairs of said closed ribs__.

4. (Currently amended) The belly pan of claim 3, including a first aero cover spanning and closing said first section of open rib structure and a second aero cover spanning and closing said second section of open rib structure __wherein said aero covers are integrally formed as a single unified structure__.

5. (Currently amended) The belly pan of claim 4, wherein said first section of open rib structure includes a first fore-aft rib and a first plurality of transverse ribs projecting from opposed sides of said first fore-aft rib __at angles between 30 and 60 degrees from vertical__.

6. (Currently amended) The belly pan of claim 5, wherein said second section of open rib structure includes a second fore-aft rib and a second plurality of transverse ribs projecting from opposed sides of said second fore-aft rib __at angles between 30 and 60 degrees from vertical__.

7. (Currently amended) The belly pan of claim 6, wherein said body panel includes a plurality of closed ribs, said first section of open rib structure being provided between a first two ribs of said plurality of closed ribs and said second section of open rib structure being provided between a second two ribs of said plurality of closed ribs __and said closed ribs are continuous from a forward edge to a rearward edge of said body panel__.

8. (Currently amended) The belly pan of claim 7, including fasteners securing said first aero cover and said second aero cover to said body panel __wherein said fasteners are positioned at intervals of no more than 50mm apart__.

9. (Currently amended) The belly pan of claim 8, wherein said body panel includes a first corner buttress and a second corner buttress __that extend rearwardly from said forward section__.

10. (Currently amended) The belly pan of claim 9, wherein said first section of open rib structure forms a part of said first buttress and said second section of open rib structure forms a part of said second buttress __and said buttresses provide structural reinforcement extending beyond said open rib structures__.

15. (Currently amended) A belly pan for a motor vehicle, comprising: a body panel having a first corner buttress, a second corner buttress, a first open rib structure reinforcing said first corner buttress and a second open rib structure reinforcing said second corner buttress __wherein said open rib structures are each flanked by closed ribs__; a first aero cover spanning and closing said first open rib structure __and bonded thereto__; and a second aero cover spanning and closing said second open rib structure __and bonded thereto__.

16. (Currently amended) The belly pan of claim 15, wherein said body panel includes a first section and a second section secured together by fasteners __and said first and second sections are aligned such that said open rib structures are continuous across the junction__.

17. (Currently amended) The belly pan of claim 16, wherein said first corner buttress is on said first section and said second corner buttress is on said second section __and each buttress extends rearwardly beyond the junction__.

18. (Currently amended) The belly pan of claim 17, wherein said first open rib structure includes a first fore-aft rib and a first plurality of transverse ribs projecting from opposed sides of said first fore-aft rib __at angles between 30 and 60 degrees from vertical__.

19. (Currently amended) The belly pan of claim 18, wherein said second open rib structure includes a second fore-aft rib and a second plurality of transverse ribs projecting from opposed sides of said second fore-aft rib __at angles between 30 and 60 degrees from vertical__.

20. (Currently amended) The belly pan of claim 19, wherein said body panel includes a plurality of closed ribs, said first section of open rib structure being provided between a first two ribs of said plurality of closed ribs and said second section of open rib structure being provided between a second two ribs of said plurality of closed ribs __and said closed ribs are continuous structures extending the full length of said body panel__.
